text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The most important item on the agenda of the forthcomming session of the Slovak parliament, starting December 4, is the 1997 state budget.

- The paper quotes unnamed sources as saying state-owned Slovak monopoly gas distributor SPP has already bought stakes in unspecified Czech gas distributors from the Czech privatisation agency, the National Property Fund.
- Slovakia's sole tyre producer Matador Puchov is testing a new tyre specially designed for the new Octavia model of the Czech car maker Skoda.
- The opposition Democratic Union (DU) said it would not support the current version of next year's budget.
- The congress of the opposition Christian Democratic Movement re-elected Jan Carnogursky as chairman at the weekend.
- Ivan Gasparovic, chairman of the Slovak parliament, on Monday begins an official visit to Moscow, where he will me the Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said the state-run export-import bank, planned to launch operations in January next year, should have 70 billion crowns at its disposal when it goes into full operation.
PRAVDA - UEC USX Engineers and Consultants of the United States has shown interest in cooperation with steel producer VSZ in the production of sheet steel.
